events.text: Generalized 'create face' beyond 1-edge-to-1-edge. Added createFaceFromEdges() to editMesh.ts: assembles selected edges into chains, fills a closed loop as one n-gon, or lofts two chains (quads for equal vert counts, two-pointer triangle strip for unequal — so a 4-edge side bridges to a 2-edge side). UI now enables create-face for >=2 edges. 4 new tests pass (54/54). NOT committed: editors/model/ untracked — flagged to user.

resolution: Generalized the Studio 'create face' op, which was restricted to bridging exactly one edge to one edge (bridgeEdges) or filling 3-4 verts. The restriction lived only in the entry points, not the mesh model — n-gon faces are already first-class (cylinder caps are n-gons) and editMeshToGeometry fan-triangulates any loop. New createFaceFromEdges() in editMesh.ts assembles the selected edges into chains by shared verts, then either fills a single closed loop as one n-gon face, or lofts a strip between two open chains: quads when the two sides have equal vert counts, a two-pointer triangle strip when they differ — so the user's 4-edge side now bridges cleanly to a 2-edge side. Studio.tsx enables create-face for >=2 edges in edge mode (was exactly 2), routing through the new function; this subsumes the old two-edge quad bridge. Four new headless tests pass (suite 54/54). NOT committed for the same reason as req_1163: editors/model/ is untracked; flagged to the user.
